descriptions: Added Compact Compass — a new compass style that sits directly above the minimap at the same width as the map.
The Compact Compass has a small moving heading tape with a direction pill (e.g. NW | 315°) in your server's theme colour.
The Compact Compass shows the street, cross street and zone, plus waypoint distance and postal code. Postal codes need nearest-postal or a similar resource.
When the Compact Compass is on, the waypoint distance shows inside it instead of in a separate pill.
Long street names now shorten automatically so nothing overlaps.
Compact Compass uses a dark frosted background that matches the floating compass and speedometer.
Switch between Floating and Compact compass with the new tabs in Settings → Compass.
Added Boxes player info layout — uses the same pills as Stacked, arranged in three rows: job / gang, money, and ID / time.
Pick Stacked Pills or Boxes with the new tabs in Player Info settings.
